newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Robeco group assets reach NLG 81.5 billion.
newsitem.headline: Robeco group assets reach NLG 81.5 billion.

text.p: The Robeco NV group of investment funds said total assets under its management rose to 81.5 billion guilders at the end of 1996 from 72.3 billion at the end of 1995.
The 1996 year-end total included 31.4 billion guilders in assets managed for institutional investors.

Total net assets of the group's equity funds -- which include the flagship Robeco and Rolinco funds -- rose to 20.1 billion guilders from 18.0 billion. Total net assets of its bond funds -- which include Rorento -- declined to 15.2 billion guilders from 18.6 billion.

Robeco said returns on investments in equities were likely to be lower in 1997 than in 1996, adding that current high valuations for equities would need to be validated by further increases in company profits.
Robeco said a favourable inflation outlook and high real interest rates meant bond markets could produce good investment results over the whole of 1997.
"Nevertheless, we would not rule out intermediate periods of rising interest rates," Robeco added.
